note: Questions for the Dyzania voice line, written by the builder from the knowledge base BEFORE any model run. 'dev' questions were used while tuning retrieval and the answer check; 'holdout' questions were written before that tuning and were run once afterwards. Every question is a same-author question: this is a regression set, not independent evidence. 'ideal' is the answer the builder hopes for (used only to check that the answer check does not block a good answer). A live model run is owed: python run_questions.py (needs GROQ_API_KEY).

fields.source: which part answers: model (the chat model, from the knowledge), or a fixed path (urgent, advice, person, change, flow) that never calls the model
fields.include: list of groups; every group needs at least one of its words in the answer (case-insensitive)
fields.sections: model questions only: at least one of these headings must be among the sections sent to the model
